signals.name: AWD clutch duty
signals.description: Meaning unverified: about 7-14 at rest, 3-20 at highway cruise and 19-34 in launches, not monotonic in clutch pressure, and briefly negative (to about -8) at lift-off or braking, so likely a signed control value rather than a duty cycle.

signals.name: AWD clutch stress
signals.description: Meaning unknown: 0 at rest, small positive values when moving.

signals.name: AWD steering wheel angle
signals.description: Sign and zero unverified: one session read about +10 deg at rest; large angles appear in parking maneuvers.

signals.name: AWD clutch torque
signals.description: Computed from clutch pressure (about 68 Nm per bar above about 0.7 bar). In launches it exceeds the total driveline torque at the transfer case, so it is likely a commanded capacity, not torque actually sent forward (inferred, assuming flat ground).

signals.name: AWD clutch pressure
signals.description: Possibly module-computed; tracks clutch torque. About 0.6-0.8 bar at rest and at steady highway cruise, about 1.5-2.6 at low speed (slow driving or braking), 6-7.5 in launches. Unit unverified.

signals.name: AWD front axle load share (estimated)
signals.description: Not a gear ratio. About 0.52 at rest; it falls under acceleration and rises under braking, like weight transfer.

signals.name: AWD axle speed difference (rear minus front)
signals.description: Inferred: rear minus front axle speed, with the sign taken from 8 moving samples; which shaft it measures is unknown.

signals.name: Doors locked? (BCM)
signals.description: Follows the door locks, not the parking brake. On a 2020 car it stays yes when only the driver's door is unlocked (two-stage unlock) or a front door is opened from inside, like a rear-door lock state (inferred); other cars' data show it set with a rear door open.

signals.name: Ignition on? (BCM)
signals.description: Set whenever the ignition is on, including with the engine off, so it is not an engine-run flag.

signals.name: Hood open?
signals.description: 1 = open, like the door and trunk bits (inferred; reads 0 on a car driven with the hood shut).

signals.name: Rear middle seatbelt latched?
signals.description: Reads a constant 1, including empty seats, on BCMs without rear belt sensing (BC04 data byte 1 = 0x37, as on one 2020 car); other BCMs appear to report real states.

signals.name: Rear left seatbelt latched?
signals.description: Reads a constant 1, including empty seats, on BCMs without rear belt sensing (BC04 data byte 1 = 0x37, as on one 2020 car); other BCMs appear to report real states.

signals.name: Rear right seatbelt latched?
signals.description: Reads a constant 1, including empty seats, on BCMs without rear belt sensing (BC04 data byte 1 = 0x37, as on one 2020 car); other BCMs appear to report real states.

signals.name: Turn/hazard lamps
signals.description: Lamp output, so it blinks at the flasher rate. Left vs right is inferred from driving data.

signals.name: Brake light
signals.description: A bitfield shown as a number: 0 = brake lamps off, nonzero (44 or 45) = on. Agrees with the TCM brake pedal bit on a 2020 car.

signals.name: Trunk lamp
signals.description: Set only while the trunk is open (inferred).

signals.name: Defog light
signals.description: Unverified: never set in any capture so far.

signals.name: Right turn lamp on?
signals.description: Lamp output, so it blinks at the flasher rate. Left vs right is inferred from driving data.

signals.name: Left turn lamp on?
signals.description: Lamp output, so it blinks at the flasher rate. Left vs right is inferred from driving data.

signals.name: Reverse selected? (BCM)
signals.description: Inferred from shift sequences at low speed; confirm with a P-R-D test.

signals.name: Park/hold flag (BCM)
signals.description: Set only at standstill, but occasionally together with reverse, so it may be Auto Hold rather than Park; hidden until a P-R-N-D test.

signals.name: Headlight high beam
signals.description: Unverified: never set in any capture so far.

signals.name: Daytime running lights on?
signals.description: On in daylight with the engine running, never together with low beams.

signals.name: Low beams on? (2018-2022 layout)
signals.description: On at night, agrees with the BCM's other lamp bits (2018-2022 layout).

signals.name: Headlight low beam (2023 layout)
signals.description: Never set on 2018-2022 cars, which report low beams at bit 60 (STINGER_LOW_BEAM).

signals.description: No value after a park of more than roughly 15-30 min, until the sensor transmits (usually a few minutes into a drive). After a short stop it usually holds the last known pressure until then, or while a sensor drops out.

signals.name: E00A byte 12 (unidentified)
signals.description: On a 2020 V6: not knock retard. Constant within a session and tracks ambient temperature (more negative in winter).

signals.name: E00A byte 13 (unidentified)
signals.description: On a 2020 V6: not knock retard, and not voltage-correlated on its own. Its low 5 bits are always 0; it behaves like the low bits of a word that continues in byte 14.

signals.name: E00A byte 14 (unidentified)
signals.description: On a 2020 V6: not knock retard. Tracks battery voltage (r = 0.82).

signals.name: E00A byte 15 (unidentified)
signals.description: On a 2020 V6: not knock retard. Behaves like the low byte of a 10-bit word (inferred).

signals.name: E00A byte 20 (unidentified)
signals.description: On a 2020 V6: not a knock-learn value. It spans the full range and loosely tracks intake air temperature.

signals.name: Cylinder air charge (raw)

signals.name: Turbo boost gauge pressure
signals.description: Pressure upstream of the throttle, so it never shows vacuum. On a 2020 car it reads 0.6-1.1 psi at idle or engine off, and the offset moves with barometric pressure, so no fixed offset zeroes it. Under boost it likely reads 1-2 psi low (11.8 shown vs about 13.4 on one 2020 car): its rise above the resting value is about a fifth too small. See the absolute throttle inlet pressure for the full-resolution reading.

signals.name: Throttle inlet (boost) pressure, absolute
signals.description: Charge-pipe pressure upstream of the throttle, absolute: about barometric pressure at rest, so subtract it for gauge boost. Scale inferred from barometric pressure at idle (within about 1%); above atmospheric it is not yet checked against SAE MAP (01 0B) at full throttle.

signals.name: Boost pressure target, absolute
signals.description: Inferred: leads the throttle inlet pressure at each tip-in, drops first at lift-off, and converges with it at steady boost. Same scale. Off boost it only means no boost is requested, and its resting level varies by car: near the inlet pressure, about 0.8 x it, or as low as about 25 kPa.

signals.name: Waste gate learned closed-position voltage
signals.description: Inferred: latched; it updates only when the waste gate is fully closed (and at engine shutdown).

signals.name: Waste gate control term (meaning unverified)
signals.description: Not a valve position: it swings between about -100% and +115%, goes negative, and does not follow the waste gate set point. Likely an internal control value (inferred).

signals.name: Waste gate control term, bank 2 (meaning unverified)
signals.description: Not a valve position: it swings between about -160% and +160%, goes negative, and does not follow the waste gate set point. Likely an internal control value (inferred).

signals.name: Fuel pressure control deviation
signals.description: Tracks target minus actual rail pressure (r = 0.97).

signals.name: Coolant temperature at engine start
signals.description: Inferred: coolant temperature latched at an engine start or stop. Below the first live reading when polling begins after the start (13.5 vs 23.25 C on one 2020 car), and it can change within a session.

signals.name: Short term fuel trim, bank 1 (E0F1)
signals.description: Short-term trim; raw 0x7F = 0%, one count below SAE 01 06/08's 0x80 (verified for bank 1 against 01 06 at every steady trim from about -5% to +5%; bank 2 inferred). Bank labels inferred (bank 2 should hold cylinders 2, 4 and 6).

signals.name: Long term fuel trim, bank 1 (E0F1)
signals.description: Inferred long-term trim; it does not always track SAE 01 07/09, and its zero point is unconfirmed (the short-term trims in this reply read 0x7F at zero). Bank labels inferred (bank 2 should hold cylinders 2, 4 and 6).

signals.name: Target lambda, bank 1
signals.description: Bank labels inferred (bank 2 should hold cylinders 2, 4 and 6).

signals.name: Short term fuel trim, bank 2 (E0F1)
signals.description: Short-term trim; raw 0x7F = 0%, one count below SAE 01 06/08's 0x80 (verified for bank 1 against 01 06 at every steady trim from about -5% to +5%; bank 2 inferred). Bank labels inferred (bank 2 should hold cylinders 2, 4 and 6).

signals.name: Long term fuel trim, bank 2 (E0F1)
signals.description: Inferred long-term trim; it does not always track SAE 01 07/09, and its zero point is unconfirmed (the short-term trims in this reply read 0x7F at zero). Bank labels inferred (bank 2 should hold cylinders 2, 4 and 6).

signals.name: Target lambda, bank 2
signals.description: Bank labels inferred (bank 2 should hold cylinders 2, 4 and 6).

signals.name: Lambda-like value, bank 1
signals.description: Equals measured lambda only near 1.0: reads about 0.70 when SAE 01 34 reads 0.90, and 2.55 marks decel fuel cut. Hidden until the scale is fitted. Bank labels inferred (bank 2 should hold cylinders 2, 4 and 6).

signals.name: Lambda-like value, bank 2
signals.description: Equals measured lambda only near 1.0: reads about 0.70 when SAE 01 34 reads 0.90, and 2.55 marks decel fuel cut. Hidden until the scale is fitted. Bank labels inferred (bank 2 should hold cylinders 2, 4 and 6).

signals.name: Current gear (E0F1)
signals.description: One bit per gear; 0 = 8th is ambiguous with no data.

signals.name: Engine coolant fan high speed, on/off
Engine oil temperature (ED02)
signals.description: Answers only on some 2020 engine variants; E001 carries oil temperature on all of them.

signals.name: Vehicle speed (TCM)
signals.description: The transmission's estimate from output-shaft speed. Reads about 5% above SAE 010D and HVAC speed, and about 3.5% above odometer distance.

signals.name: Torque converter turbine speed (transmission input)
signals.description: Not the turbocharger; turbo shaft speed is not reported. Equals engine speed minus converter slip, and reads 0 when stopped in gear.

signals.name: Gear selector
signals.description: Selector position. 8-11 verified against gear and speed; 12 (manual) inferred.

signals.name: Current gear
signals.description: Gear engaged. Raw 0 = Park or Neutral, 1-8 = gear, 14 = Reverse.
